body.title: Heat pump options
body.markdown:
The gas boiler at 12 Maple Street is 19 years old. The installer's quotes are in the shared folder; scores are from the family meeting.

```matrix
title: Which heat pump do we buy?
criteria: Price*3, Noise*2, Efficiency*3, Installer nearby*2
scale: 1-5
- Air-to-water, 8 kW: 4, 3, 4, 5
- Air-to-water, quiet model: 3, 5, 4, 4
- Ground source: 1, 5, 5, 2
- Hybrid with the old boiler: 5, 3, 2, 4
```

The neighbours at number 14 have the quiet model and are happy with it.
